articles.title_cn: 序贯拍卖中的损失厌恶
authors: Rosato, Antonio (School of Economics, University of Queensland and CSEF)
Antonio Rosato
articles.abstract_en: I analyze sequential auctions with expectations-based loss-averse bidders who have independent private values and unit demand. Equilibrium bids are history dependent and subject to a discouragement effect: the higher the winning bid in the current round is, the less aggressive the bids of the remaining bidders in the next round. Moreover, because they experience a loss in each round in which they fail to obtain an object, bidders are willing to pay a premium in order to win sooner rather than later. This desire to win earlier leads prices to decline in equilibrium. I also show how various disclosure policies regarding the outcome of earlier auctions affect equilibrium bids, and that sequential and simultaneous auctions are neither bidder-payoff equivalent nor revenue equivalent.
articles.abstract_cn: 我分析了序贯拍卖，其中竞标者具有基于预期的损失厌恶、独立私人价值和单位需求。均衡出价依赖于历史，并受到一种劝阻效应的影响：当前轮次的获胜出价越高，下一轮次中剩余竞标者的出价就越不激进。此外，由于他们在每一轮未能获得物品时都会经历损失，竞标者愿意支付溢价以便更早而非更晚获胜。这种更早获胜的愿望导致均衡中价格下降。我还展示了关于较早拍卖结果的各种披露政策如何影响均衡出价，并且序贯拍卖和同时拍卖既不是竞标者收益等价的，也不是收入等价的。

authors: Kaya, Ayça (Department of Economics, University of Miami)
Ayca Kaya
articles.abstract_en: The founder of a start-up (principal) who has a project with uncertain returns must retain and incentivize an agent using promise of future payments and information gathering. The agent's effort incrementally advances production and such advance is a prerequisite for gathering new information. The principal decides how much information to gather based on these incremental advancements. The principal faces cash constraints. The agent's outside option is large relative to his effort cost. Equilibrium features one of two outcomes: immediate learning, whereby the agent's compensation is low, learning is immediate and retention is possible only conditional on the project being of high quality; or gradual learning, whereby the agent's compensation is high, learning is gradual, the agent never quits and effort is inefficiently high.
articles.abstract_cn: 一位初创企业创始人（委托人）拥有一个收益不确定的项目，必须通过未来支付承诺和信息收集来留住并激励一位代理人。代理人的努力逐步推进生产，而这种推进是收集新信息的前提条件。委托人根据这些逐步推进来决定收集多少信息。委托人面临现金约束。代理人的外部选项相对于其努力成本而言较大。均衡呈现两种结果之一：即时学习，即代理人的报酬低，学习是即时的，且只有在项目为高质量时才能留住代理人；或渐进学习，即代理人的报酬高，学习是渐进的，代理人从不退出，且努力无效率地高。

authors: Dillenberger, David (Department of Economics, University of Pennsylvania)
Krishna, R. Vijay (Florida State University)
Sadowski, Philipp (Duke University)
articles.abstract_en: We propose a class of dynamic models that capture subjective (and hence unobservable) constraints on the amount of information a decision maker can acquire, pay attention to, or absorb, via an Information Choice Process (ICP). An ICP specifies the information that can be acquired about the payoff-relevant state in the current period, and how this choice affects what can be learned in the future. In spite of their generality, wherein ICPs can accommodate any dependence of the information constraint on the history of information choices and state realizations, we show that the constraints imposed by them are identified up to a dynamic extension of Blackwell dominance. All the other parameters of the model are also uniquely identified.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一类动态模型，通过信息选择过程（ICP）来刻画决策者在获取、关注或吸收信息量上所面临的主观（因而不可观测的）约束。ICP规定了在当前期关于与支付相关状态可以获取的信息，以及这一选择如何影响未来可学习的内容。尽管具有一般性，即ICP可以容纳信息约束对信息选择历史与状态实现的任意依赖，我们表明它们所施加的约束在Blackwell占优的动态扩展意义下可被识别。模型的所有其他参数也被唯一识别。

articles.title_en: Optimal redistribution with a shadow economy
articles.title_cn: 影子经济下的最优再分配
authors: Doligalski, Paweł (School of Economics, University of Bristol)
Rojas, Luis E. (Department of Economics and Economic History, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona and Barcelona School of Economics)
Luis E. Rojas
articles.abstract_en: We extend the theory of optimal redistributive taxation to economies with an informal sector. In particular, in our model workers can supply labor simultaneously to the formal and the informal sectors, which we call moonlighting. The optimal tax formula contains two novel terms capturing informality responses on an intensive and an extensive margin. Both terms decrease the optimal tax rates. We estimate the model with Colombian data and find that informality strongly reduces tax rates at all income levels. The possibility to migrate to entirely informal employment restricts tax rates at low and medium income levels, while the possibility of moonlighting is relevant at higher earnings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将最优再分配税收理论扩展到存在非正规部门的经济体。特别地，在我们的模型中，工人可以同时向正规部门和非正规部门提供劳动，我们称之为兼职。最优税收公式包含两个新项，分别捕捉集约边际和广延边际上的非正规性反应。这两个项都降低最优税率。我们用哥伦比亚数据估计该模型，发现非正规性在所有收入水平上强烈降低税率。迁移到完全非正规就业的可能性限制了低和中等收入水平的税率，而兼职的可能性在高收入水平上相关。

articles.title_en: On rank dominance of tie-breaking rules
articles.title_cn: 论平局打破规则的排名优势
authors: Allman, Maxwell (Department Management Science and Engineering, Stanford University)
Ashlagi, Itai (Department Management Science and Engineering, Stanford University)
Nikzad, Afshin (Department of Economics, University of Southern California)
articles.abstract_en: Lotteries are a common way to resolve ties in assignment mechanisms that ration resources. We consider a model with a continuum of agents and a finite set of re- sources with heterogeneous qualities, where the agents’ preferences are generated from a multinomial-logit (MNL) model based on the resource qualities. We show that all agents prefer a common lottery to independent lotteries at each resource if every resource is popular, meaning that the mass of agents ranking that resource as their first choice exceeds its capacity. We then prove a stronger result where the assumption that every resource is popular is not required and agents’ preferences are drawn from a (more general) nested MNL model. By appropriately adapting the notion of popularity to resource types, we show that a hybrid tie-breaking rule in which the objects in each popular type share a common lottery dominates independent lotteries at each resource.
articles.abstract_cn: 抽签是资源配给分配机制中解决平局的常见方式。我们考虑一个具有连续统主体和有限异质质量资源集合的模型，其中主体的偏好由基于资源质量的多项Logit（MNL）模型生成。我们证明，如果每种资源都受欢迎，即将该资源列为首选的主体数量超过其容量，那么所有主体都偏好每种资源上的共同抽签而非独立抽签。随后我们证明了一个更强的结果，其中不需要每种资源都受欢迎的假设，且主体的偏好来自（更一般的）嵌套MNL模型。通过适当地将受欢迎的概念适应于资源类型，我们证明，在每种受欢迎类型中的对象共享共同抽签的混合平局打破规则，优于每种资源上的独立抽签。

authors: Manjunath, Vikram (Department of Economics, University of Ottawa)
Morrill, Thayer (Department of Economics, North Carolina State University)
articles.abstract_en: Many centralized matching markets are preceded by interviews between participants, including the residency matches between doctors and hospitals. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, interviews in the National Resident Matching Program were switched to a virtual format, which resulted in a dramatic and asymmetric decrease in the cost of accepting interview invitations. We study the impact of an increase in the number of doctors’ interviews on their final matches. We show analytically that if doctors can accept more interviews, but hospitals do not increase the number of interviews they offer, then no doctor who would have matched in the setting with more limited interviews is better off, and many doctors are potentially harmed. This adverse effect is the result of what we call \emph{interview hoarding}. We characterize optimal mitigation strategies for special cases and use simulations to extend these insights to more general settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多集中匹配市场在参与者之间进行面试之前，包括医生与医院之间的住院医师匹配。由于COVID-19大流行，国家住院医师匹配计划中的面试改为虚拟形式，这导致接受面试邀请的成本急剧且不对称地下降。我们研究医生面试数量增加对其最终匹配的影响。我们通过分析表明，如果医生可以接受更多面试，但医院不增加他们提供的面试数量，那么原本在面试更有限的环境中能够匹配的医生都不会变得更好，而许多医生可能受到损害。这种不利影响是我们称之为\emph{面试囤积}的结果。我们刻画了特殊情况下的最优缓解策略，并使用模拟将这些见解扩展到更一般的情况。

articles.title_en: Distance on matchings: an axiomatic approach
articles.title_cn: 匹配上的距离：一种公理化方法
authors: Can, Burak (Department of Data Analytics and Digitalisation, Maastricht University)
Pourpouneh, Mohsen (Center for Blockchains and Electronic Markets, University of Copenhagen)
Storcken, Ton (Department of Quantitative Economics, Maastricht University)
Burak Can
articles.abstract_en: Matchings in a market may have varying degrees of compromise from efficiency, fairness, and or stability. A distance function allows to quantify such concepts or the (dis)similarity between any two matchings. There are a few attempts to propose such functions, however these are tailored for specific applications and ignore the individual preferences completely. In this paper, we construct a normative framework to quantify the difference between outcomes of market mechanisms in matching markets, while endogenizing the preferences of the individuals into the distance concept. Several conditions are introduced to capture natural and appealing behavior of such functions. We find a class of distance functions called \textit{scaled Borda distances}, which is the only class of distance functions that satisfies these conditions simultaneously.
articles.abstract_cn: 市场中的匹配可能在效率、公平和/或稳定性方面具有不同程度的妥协。距离函数允许量化这些概念或任意两个匹配之间的（不）相似性。已有一些尝试提出此类函数，然而这些函数是为特定应用量身定制的，并且完全忽略了个人偏好。在本文中，我们构建了一个规范性框架，以量化匹配市场中市场机制结果之间的差异，同时将个人的偏好内生化到距离概念中。我们引入了若干条件来捕捉此类函数的自然且吸引人的行为。我们发现了一类称为\textit{scaled Borda distances}的距离函数，这是唯一同时满足这些条件的距离函数类。

articles.title_en: Multilevel marketing: pyramid-shaped schemes or exploitative scams?
articles.title_cn: 多层次营销：金字塔式计划还是剥削性骗局？
authors: Antler, Yair (Coller School of Management, Tel Aviv University)
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by the growing discussion on the resemblance of multilevel marketing schemes to pyramid scams, we compare the two phenomena based on their underlying compensation structures. We show that a company can design a pyramid scam to exploit a network of agents with coarse beliefs and that this requires the company to charge the participants a license fee and pay them a recruitment commission for each of the people that they recruit and that their recruits recruit. We characterize the schemes that maximize a company's profit when it faces fully rational agents, and establish that the company never finds it profitable to charge them a license fee or pay them recruitment commissions.
articles.abstract_cn: 受关于多层次营销计划与金字塔骗局相似性的日益增多的讨论所启发，我们基于二者 underlying 的薪酬结构对这两种现象进行比较。我们表明，一家公司可以设计一个金字塔骗局来利用一个具有粗信念的代理人网络，而这要求公司向参与者收取许可费，并为他们招募的每个人以及他们的被招募者所招募的每个人支付招募佣金。我们刻画了当公司面对完全理性的代理人时能够最大化其利润的计划，并确立该公司从不会发现向他们收取许可费或支付招募佣金是有利可图的。

articles.title_en: The limits of ex post implementation without transfers
articles.title_cn: 无转移支付的事后实施的局限
authors: Feng, Tangren (Department of Decision Sciences and IGIER, Bocconi University)
Niemeyer, Axel (Department of Economics, University of Bonn)
Wu, Qinggong (Department of Economics, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology)
articles.abstract_en: We study ex post implementation in collective decision problems where monetary transfers cannot be used. We find that deterministic ex post implementation is impossible if the underlying environment is neither almost an environment with private values nor almost one with common values. Thus, desirable properties of ex post implementation such as informational robustness become difficult to achieve when preference interdependence and preference heterogeneity are both present in the environment.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在不能使用货币转移支付的集体决策问题中的事后实施。我们发现，如果潜在环境既不是几乎私人价值的环境，也不是几乎共同价值的环境，那么确定性的事后实施是不可能的。因此，当偏好相互依赖和偏好异质性同时存在于环境中时，事后实施的理想性质如信息稳健性变得难以实现。

articles.title_en: Equilibrium existence in games with ties
articles.title_cn: 存在平局博弈中的均衡存在性
authors: Olszewski, Wojciech (Department of Economics, Northwestern University)
Siegel, Ron (Department of Economics, The Pennsylvania State University)
articles.abstract_en: We provide conditions that simplify applying Reny's (1999) better-reply security to Bayesian games, and use these conditions to prove the existence of equilibria for classes of games in which payoff discontinuities arise only at "ties." These games include a general version of all-pay contests, first-prize auctions with common values, and Hotelling models with incomplete information.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了简化将 Reny（1999）的更好回应安全性应用于贝叶斯博弈的条件，并利用这些条件证明了一类博弈的均衡存在性，在这类博弈中，支付不连续性仅在“平局”处出现。这些博弈包括全支付竞赛的一般版本、具有共同价值的一等奖拍卖，以及具有不完全信息的 Hotelling 模型。

articles.title_en: Optimal assignment mechanisms with imperfect verification
articles.title_cn: 不完全验证下的最优分配机制
authors: Pereyra, Juan Sebastián (Department of Economics, Universidad de la Republica)
Silva, Francisco (Department of Economics, Deakin University)
Juan Sebastian Pereyra
Francisco Silva
articles.abstract_en: Objects of different quality are to be allocated to agents. Agents can receive at most one object, and there are not enough high-quality objects for every agent. The value to the social planner from allocating objects to any given agent depends on that agent's private information. The social planner is unable to use transfers to give incentives for agents to convey their private information. Instead, she is able to imperfectly verify their reports through signals that are positively affiliated with each agent's type. We characterize mechanisms that maximize the social planner's expected payoff. In the optimal mechanism, each agent chooses one of various tracks, which are characterized by two thresholds. If the agent's signal exceeds the upper threshold of the chosen track, the agent receives a high-quality object, if it is in-between the two thresholds, he receives a low-quality object and if it is below the lower threshold, he receives no object.
articles.abstract_cn: 不同质量的物品将被分配给代理人。代理人最多只能获得一件物品，且高质量物品不足以分配给每一位代理人。社会规划者将物品分配给任意给定代理人所带来的价值取决于该代理人的私人信息。社会规划者无法使用转移支付来激励代理人传递其私人信息。相反，她能够通过与每个代理人的类型正相关的信号来不完全验证他们的报告。我们刻画了最大化社会规划者期望收益的机制。在最优机制中，每个代理人选择多种轨道之一，这些轨道由两个阈值刻画。如果代理人的信号超过所选轨道的上阈值，该代理人获得一件高质量物品；如果信号位于两个阈值之间，他获得一件低质量物品；如果低于下阈值，他什么也得不到。

articles.title_en: Characterizing the top cycle via strategyproofness
articles.title_cn: 通过策略防伪性刻画顶部循环
authors: Brandt, Felix (Department of Computer Science, Technische Universität München)
Lederer, Patrick (Computer Science Department, Technische Universität München)
articles.abstract_en: Gibbard and Satterthwaite have shown that the only single-valued social choice functions (SCFs) that satisfy non-imposition (i.e., the function's range coincides with its codomain) and strategyproofness (i.e., voters are never better off by misrepresenting their preferences) are dictatorships. In this paper, we consider set-valued social choice correspondences (SCCs) that are strategyproof according to Fishburn's preference extension and, in particular, the top cycle, an attractive SCC that returns the maximal elements of the transitive closure of the weak majority relation. Our main theorem shows that, under mild conditions, the top cycle is the only non-imposing strategyproof SCC whose outcome only depends on the quantified pairwise comparisons between alternatives. This result effectively turns the Gibbard-Satterthwaite impossibility into a complete characterization of the top cycle by moving from SCFs to SCCs. We also leverage key ideas of the proof of this statement to obtain a more general characterization of strategyproof SCCs.
articles.abstract_cn: Gibbard和Satterthwaite已经表明，唯一满足非强加性（即函数的值域与其陪域一致）和策略防伪性（即选民永远不会通过虚假陈述其偏好而变得更好）的单值社会选择函数（SCFs）是独裁。在本文中，我们考虑根据Fishburn的偏好扩展是策略防伪的集值社会选择对应（SCCs），特别是顶部循环，这是一个有吸引力的SCC，它返回弱多数关系传递闭包的最大元素。我们的主要定理表明，在温和条件下，顶部循环是唯一的非强加策略防伪SCC，其结果仅取决于备选项之间的量化成对比较。这一结果通过从SCFs转向SCCs，有效地将Gibbard-Satterthwaite不可能性转化为对顶部循环的完整刻画。我们还利用该陈述证明的关键思想，获得了策略防伪SCCs的更一般刻画。
